text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Mejiro Dober buying a massive 
amount of aroma oils at the shopping 
mall...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To fall asleep... lavender, right? For 
relaxing... cypress...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eucalyptus for focus, and... then rose and 
lemongrass...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I should just buy one of 
everything. Everything's starting to look 
necessary to me now..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober appears to be noticeably 
fatigued. It might be best to hold off on 
racing for now.
